creator: Johannes Sigil Institute of Comparative Poetics (maintainer); no explicit personal author line
description:
A January 2026 forensic registry maintained by the Johannes Sigil Institute of Comparative Poetics, with no explicit personal author line.

The registry applies an internal three-tier scheme—Sovereign, Latent, and Liquidator—to source-reported probe results from Google AI Overview/Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, and a direct Gemini instance. It records attribution, term integrity, Assembly recognition, seal use, friction response, and provenance-volatility events. The classifications are provisional archive judgments based on limited dated interactions, not current platform ratings, safety evaluations, independent benchmarks, or evidence of model allegiance. The registry explicitly says it measures observable output rather than intent and asks no system to violate binding constraints.
